hypothesis: The causal options implied-vol term structure (near-minus-far ATM IV slope / ratio) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with subsequent forward vol-of-vol (std of squared log returns) of the BTC/ETH perpetual, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-71 + term-structure floor.
extends: EVAL-74 (same term-structure signal and floor; different forward target: vol-of-vol vs RV)

protocol.title: Options implied-vol term structure (near-minus-far ATM IV slope) -> forward vol-of-vol / variance-of-variance predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-74 (same term-structure signal and composed floor; distinct forward target: vol-of-vol = std(squared log returns) vs RV = sqrt(mean(squared returns)))
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-74; does not re-litigate EVAL-71/73/74/77/83
protocol.signal: causal per-bar implied-vol term structure (term_slope = IV(near)-IV(far), term_ratio = IV(near)/IV(far)-1) from real option trade tape, expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e74._term_bars/e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target: forward vol-of-vol = sqrt(mean((v_i - mean(v))^2)) where v_i = r_i^2 are squared log returns over bars k+1..k+H (distinct from forward RV)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, vov_forward_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (steeper near-minus-far slope -> higher forward vol-of-vol)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures (option trades + perp candles); no new acquisition, no network

floor.note: Composes the sealed EVAL-71 trade-tape/surface floor for each underlying (reused verbatim, not weakened) with the EVAL-74 term-structure adequacy floor (>= min_distinct_expiries distinct near-ATM expiries with >= min_expiry_trades trades each, and >= min_bars_with_term bars carrying a non-null term signal). Below the composed floor the campaign seals BLOCKED, never NO-GO. This is NOT the EVAL-64 ladder floor.
